caption: A fleece blanket is shaken out in a dark bedroom, and small flickers of light run through the fabric.

sa.check: A fleece blanket in a dark bedroom.
Small flickers of light run through the fabric.
The flickers come while the blanket moves, not while it is still.

pc.expect: The flickers appear only as the fabric moves and separates from itself, and each is gone at once; while the blanket is still there is no glow.
pc.fail: The blanket glows steadily like a lamp; or flickers keep running through it after it has been laid still; or a flicker stays lit at one spot; or the fabric glows before it is shaken.

pc.expect: One blanket; the flickers leave nothing behind on the fabric.
pc.fail: Glowing dots stay on the blanket after the flicker; or a second blanket appears; or the blanket vanishes; or the flickers detach and float in the room.

pc.expect: The blanket is soft fabric: it billows, folds and drapes as it is shaken and falls in folds when let go.
pc.fail: The blanket stands stiff like a board; or stretches out like elastic; or hangs in the air as a fixed shape after the shake; or flows like liquid.

pc.expect: The flickers are small: they brighten only the fabric right around them and not the room.
pc.fail: The room lights up with each flicker as if a lamp came on; or the flickers throw shadows across the walls; or the flickers stay lit and light the room.

pc.expect: The blanket passes through nothing; the bed and furniture keep their shapes.
pc.fail: The blanket passes through the bed or a wall; or the blanket merges with the bedding; or furniture changes shape; or a hand passes through the blanket.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The blanket's colour and pattern and the room stay the same apart from the flickers.
pc.fail: The blanket changes colour or pattern; or the room's contents rearrange; or the flickers change the blanket's colour where they pass.

note: Who shakes the blanket is not judged.
